title: Legacy fixture — assignment carrying the retired "AI Formative" type
preamble: This fixture exists only to prove back-compatibility. It is shaped like an assignment exported before 2026-08-18, when the "AI Formative" submission type was retired. Loading it should succeed: the formative parts render as ordinary plain text answers, with no purple AI badge, no word-count target, and no offer of a resubmission. Nothing should error and no part should disappear.

problems.name: Section 1 — Design Decisions
problems.description: Report section carrying parts authored under the retired type.

subsections.name: Gain-split justification
subsections.description: Explain how you divided total gain between the instrumentation amplifier and the summing stage, and why that split suits your sensor.

subsections.name: Filter design rationale
subsections.description: Justify your choice of corner frequency for the low-pass filter with reference to your sampling rate.

problems.name: Control — unaffected part types
problems.description: These parts use current types. They must be unchanged by the legacy handling above, which is the point of including them.

subsections.name: Measured resolution
subsections.description: State the smallest mass change your scale resolves, with units.

subsections.name: Error source
subsections.description: Identify the dominant error source in your chain and explain in a short paragraph how you established that it dominates.
